keiyo-passenger-arms.transformation: Replace the false Nishi-Funabashi–Futamata-Shinmachi branch interval with two evidenced passenger arms to Minami-Funabashi and Ichikawa-Shiohama; exact survey joins, canonical station anchors and unchanged trunk.
keiyo-passenger-arms.structurePolicy: No bridge/tunnel/layer attributes exist in the selected raw N02 features. Omit structure on the rebuilt arms rather than reusing invalid source-branch measures. Trunk annotations stay unchanged.

source.role: Secondary cached passenger railway geometry for display only; fetch date does not certify tracing date, accuracy or independent imagery provenance.

keiyo-display-curves.displayPolicy: Replace only two reviewed tail windows with exact ordered points of one connected passenger main track. Preserve both N02 seams as display aliases within15m, canonical station anchors, physical N02 geometry/mileage, identities/dates and all unrelated records. No interpolated projection points, averaged tracks, sidings, freight-only edges or crossover permissions.
keiyo-display-curves.historicalUncertainty: Minami selected ways retain Bing,2010/7–2011/6 source tags. Ichikawa selected/parallel ways have no tracing-source tag. No independent survey, imagery year, operating direction, dated physical change or automatic Apple pixel acceptance is asserted.

keiyo-midcurve.policy: Display-only continuation of the same selected passenger track; retain earlier tail override, canonical source geometry, station coordinates, kilometres and topology. Native Apple review required. At the east survey entrance replace the single retained display alias with the exact selected track endpoint (11.75448m); canonical source/fork and all other display supports remain unchanged.

surveyEntrance.reason: Native east-fork dent comes from retaining an off-track N02 alias before the pinned passenger survey. Replace this one display alias with the exact first selected track endpoint; retain fork and all other supports.

keiyo-shared-corridor.policy: One same-company passenger representative only from the real east fork to Minami-Funabashi. Reuse the already reviewed eastern arm display survey in reverse on the trunk; retain independent approach before the fork, all physical station/segment/mileage identities, western arm and different-company corridors. This does not certify Apple pixel alignment or a new nationwide corridor-centre survey.

keiyo-west-shared-corridor.policy: One same-company passenger representative from the real west fork to Ichikawa-Shiohama. Exact common canonical N02 feature14150 reversed and station-clipped14152 justify this bounded corridor; copy the already reviewed western tail in the same direction onto the trunk. Keep feature14147 independent approach and all physical station, segment, identity and mileage fields. No precision track-centre or Apple pixel acceptance claim.

identityReferences.purpose: Four passenger faces, platform order and group identity
Approximate native basemap calibration and representative central band corroboration
JR East official platform and station diagram

keiyo-minami-passenger-centre.policy: Local display-only Minami-Funabashi station and both approaches. Retain original outside supports, physical stations, segments, mileage, real fork and survey entrance. Recompute affected native rulers and measured shared ownership; reject unknown references. East source seam is retained at [139.99978,35.67963]; first new common-longitude support139.99874 avoids the short reverse pair from the nearer original alias139.99788.
keiyo-minami-passenger-centre.evidenceBoundary: All four identified passenger platform faces belong to the station group. Inner OSM service=siding ways remain passenger corroboration. Fixed-longitude midpoint of identified outer tracks defines display representative only. Official diagram, firsthand photo and native basemap pixels independently corroborate platform group and point placement; Apple screenshot coordinates are approximate cartographic evidence, not WGS84 survey.

source.role: Secondary cached passenger railway geometry for display only; fetch date does not certify tracing date, accuracy or independent imagery provenance.

keiyo-shio-transverse-display.policy: Display-only transverse alignment retaining the original station longitudinal seed through perpendicular image projection. Two identified JR passenger tracks define a central display corridor, not a blended physical survey. Use the union of original and both surveyed latitude supports inside the local window; full source/image lateral correction only in the image-covered latitude range35.66555–35.667547, tapering to zero at exact retained boundaries. Preserve real fork, all outside support coordinates, physical stations/segments/mileage/IDs and Minami stage.
keiyo-shio-transverse-display.evidenceBoundary: Root inspected the Apple image trace following railway rather than road; image-derived point has 145/147 supported profiles and about7.98m northwest transverse correction, with prior identified JR track mean about6.5m northwest corroboration. No platform centre, longitudinal recenter, physical survey or native final acceptance claim.

policy: Display corridor mean with orthogonal longitudinal station projection; not a surveyed platform centre; physical topology/mileage preserved.
